**Description**

`typescript`, `data-grid`, `canvas`, `spreadsheet`, `react`, `vue`, `headless`, `rich-text`, `mcp`, `mit-license`

Leave the project website unset until a public demo/documentation domain is confirmed. Do not use `acheron-grid-demo.test`. Author website: [Hao Duong](https://haoduong.dev/).

Experimental development preview; packages are not published. Do not describe this repository as a stable release or enterprise support offering.
